markscheme.html:
9a

On a travelling wave the phase of particles within a wavelength varies, on a standing wave particles between two adjacent nodes have the same phase.

Travelling waves have a constant amplitude, the amplitude of a standing wave varies with position.

Travelling waves have neither nodes, nor antinodes, standing waves have nodes and antinodes.

Travelling waves propagate energy, standing waves do not propagate energy.
